fields.name: ArgentSeaOrleansMembershipTable membership-table library surface
fields.contract: ArgentSeaOrleansMembershipTable provides one cluster-scoped membership-table surface. It can optionally establish that cluster's initial version record; remove defunct entries before a supplied UTC cutoff; remove all entries for an explicitly supplied cluster; insert a complete silo membership record while presenting a table version; read either all records or one addressed record together with the table version; update only a record's liveness time; and replace a record while presenting both its record ETag and table version. Insert and replacement report successful completion with true; callers receive the membership data reconstructed from the table's version, member, and suspect result sets.
